issues: The angles are not in proportion to the working: the working gives |AOB| = 50 and |ACB| = 25 degrees, but the figure draws AOB at about 107 degrees and ACB at about 55 degrees (chord AB is drawn far too wide for a 50 degree centre angle).
The label O sits on the line OB, touching the stroke.

The line label l renders like a capital I and is hard to read.
